finding.headline: "My Scar Itches When It Rains (long-term numbness/itch)"
finding.problem: "Three years later my scar itches so badly I scratch in my sleep. People act like it's nothing. No one told me numbness could last this long."
finding.recurring_situation: HIDDEN MARKET — "How do I function normally again after a C-section while caring for a newborn?"
